references.text: The sons of the Gershonites are mentioned here with the same names: Libni and Shimei, confirming the lineage from Exodus.
The Libnites and Shimeites are named as the clans descended from Gershon, showing how the sons formed the foundation of the Levitical families.
The Gershonites are listed among the Levitical clans in the census on the plains of Moab.
Libni and Shimei are named as sons of Gershon in the genealogical record of the Levites in Chronicles.
The clans of the Gershonites are mentioned in connection with the organization of the Levites' service under David.
Gershon is named as one of Levi's sons when Jacob's family went down to Egypt.
